author_scope: B01 author supplemental source audit, not independent approval of own configs
finding: Physical base_link is axle midpoint; existing TEB/DWA apply nonholonomic trajectory models to that pose, while physical wheel geometry assumes a laterally fixed rear axle. Actual midpoint vy includes rigid-body turning and cannot be interpreted wholly as side slip. This source-confirmed model-reference mismatch does not itself establish any live N04 failure attribution.

semantics.odom: P05 world velocity at base link origin rotated into base coordinates; no inventedvy, no rear reference conversion. Pose/TF and child_frame_id are base_link.
semantics.command: Shared coordinator rejects all nonzero lateral method commands then passes v/w through. Physical P05 maps atan(L*w/v), clips steering, advances reference dynamics and wheel effort. It does not translate planner base-point lateral velocity into rear-point velocity.
semantics.DWA: Costmap robot pose/footprint at base_link; rawodom helper forwards vx/vy/w without transforming. When |vy|<=.125 (ignoring float32 edge rounding), sampledvy window collapses0. Outside it reverses lower>upper; VelocityIterator coerces1requested sample into2 endpoints, including0 andnonzero. A nonzero sample may be selected, but no selection/fault certainty is claimed.
semantics.TEB: Robot pose/footprint at base_link; carlike edge soft nonholonomic constraint assumes displacement aligned with bodyheading at that point. Actual axle-midpoint motion has perpendicular term .325*w even underideal no-slip. min_turning_radius/kinematicweights are softoptimization terms, not an exact physical trajectory guarantee.
semantics.footprint: Current base-frame compound polygon is geometrically consistent with currentbase pose. Reference repair must translate BOTH pose/twist and polygon together; changing onlyrobot_base_frame or zeroing odomvy would be wrong.
semantics.analytic_PCT: Frozen route_candidate_core already calls base_pose_to_rear andbase_twist_to_rear, integrates rearstate andtransforms back tobase for physical footprint/goal; this baseline reference mismatch is a fairness limitation prior tostrong tuning.

proposed_new_engineering_factor.name: rear_axle_planning_reference_adapter
proposed_new_engineering_factor.stage: new separately reviewed engineering qualification before B01 tuning execution; no currentruntime edits or IDs
proposed_new_engineering_factor.transform: r_BR=(-L/2,0,0); p_R=p_B+R_B*r_BR; v_R^B=v_B^B+omega_B cross r_BR. Planar vy_R=vy_B-L*w/2; vx_R=vx_B. Preserve source stamp and true residual rearvy; never forcevy=0.
proposed_new_engineering_factor.tf: Add unique static base_link->rear_axle_plan reference; keep authoritative originalodom/base TF intact. Dedicated plannerodom childrear, with pose/twistandcovariance consistently transformed. Preserve full3D transform/covariance and declareplanar scope.
proposed_new_engineering_factor.footprint: Existing TEB16 and costmap64 vertices in rear frame become(x+L/2,y). Sameworldoccupiedset and0.33margin, no removal of wheel/steer collision support.
proposed_new_engineering_factor.planner_inputs: Bind both costmap robot_base_frame and plannerodom torear reference. Translate planner terminal goal andguidepoints using theirorientations so original base-centered sharedgoal/route semantics are preserved; no mapgeometry/oracle change.
proposed_new_engineering_factor.common_output: Keep shared public v/w and physicalbackend/controller unchanged; now declare their bicycle rearreference semantics explicitly. Core evaluator stilluses actualbase geometry.
qualification: Exact source-stamp and nofuture TF/odom joins, unique frameownership; no truthinput.
Offline straight/left/right, pose/twist covariance transformations, identicalworldfootprint vertices andsensortransforms.
Fresh boundedphysical constantcurvature +transients compare actual midpointvy, rearvy residual, worldpath andbothplanners internaltrajectory reference; all negativesretained.
Replay actualDWA samplewindows andstrict zero lateralcommand contract overqualifiedrange; no arbitraryacc_y escalation.
Checksharedbasegoal stopping/heading androute semantics unchanged afterreference shift; then independentrelease andbaseline-tuning approval.
proposed_new_engineering_factor.remaining_limit: DWA v/w rollouts still lack explicit carlike curvature/steering-slew feasibility; reference adaptation alone does not make every DWA proposal physically feasible. TEBCarlike weights/targetbounds still require execution checks.

limits: Synthetic no-slip formulas are not live measurements; realfriction/slip/tilt may change actualvalues.

    def step(self,state,action,dt,braking=False,hold=False):
        c=self.config;x,y,yaw=state['rear'];projection=self.project(state['base'][:2])
        # Aim inside the goal ball: stopping at its longitudinal edge leaves
        # no allowance for residual cross-track error on a curved guide.
        remaining=max(0.,self.route.length-projection['arc_m']-.5*c.goal_tolerance_m)
        target_speed=state['vx'] if hold else (0. if braking or action==0 else min(SPEEDS[action],math.sqrt(2*c.deceleration_mps2*remaining)))
        if hold:desired=state['steer']
        elif braking or action==0:desired=0.
        else:
            sample=self.route.sample(projection['arc_m']+c.lookahead_m)
            offset=OFFSETS[action]*math.sin(math.pi*min(1.,projection['arc_m']/self.route.length))
            target=(sample[0]-math.sin(sample[2])*offset,sample[1]+math.cos(sample[2])*offset,sample[2])
            target_rear=base_pose_to_rear(target,c.wheelbase_m)
            bearing=wrap_angle(math.atan2(target_rear[1]-y,target_rear[0]-x)-yaw)
            desired=math.atan2(2*c.wheelbase_m*math.sin(bearing),max(.05,math.dist((x,y),target_rear[:2])))
            if remaining<1.0:
                goal_error=wrap_angle(self.route.goal_yaw-state['base'][2])
                # Keep terminal cross-track correction; heading alone could
                # stop a laterally displaced candidate outside the base goal.
                desired=math.atan(c.wheelbase_m*(2*goal_error-2*projection['lateral_m']))
            desired=max(-c.maximum_steering_rad,min(c.maximum_steering_rad,desired))
        speed=state['vx']+max(-c.deceleration_mps2*dt,min(c.acceleration_mps2*dt,target_speed-state['vx']))
        steer=state['steer']+max(-c.maximum_steering_rate_radps*dt,min(c.maximum_steering_rate_radps*dt,desired-state['steer']))
        w=speed*math.tan(steer)/c.wheelbase_m;angle=wrap_angle(yaw+.5*(state['w']+w)*dt);middle=wrap_angle(yaw+.25*(state['w']+w)*dt)
        mean_v=.5*(state['vx']+speed);vy=state['vy']
        rear=(x+(mean_v*math.cos(middle)-vy*math.sin(middle))*dt,y+(mean_v*math.sin(middle)+vy*math.cos(middle))*dt,angle)
        return dict(state,rear=rear,base=rear_pose_to_base(rear,c.wheelbase_m),vx=speed,w=w,steer=steer,t=state['t']+dt)
